name: WVSSAC State Cross Country Championships
where: Ona, WV · host Cabell Midland · Cabell Midland XC Course
headline: WVSSAC State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Morgantown swept the Class AAAA titles, the boys scoring 46 points and the girls 47 (Cabell Midland second with 80), as University's Micah Gainer repeated as boys champion in 15:39.7 and Musselman's Sadie Yates won the girls race in 17:54. Elkins swept Class AAA (boys 63, girls 51), with Keyser's Luca Altobello (15:45.2) and Bridgeport's Aria Selario (18:51) winning the individual races. St. Marys won the Class A boys title (43) and Ritchie County the girls (44), and Frankfort (47) and Lincoln (44) won the Class AA titles.
